notes.title: “Gyutaro Character Pack” Launches Today!
notes.content:
The “Gyutaro Character Pack” is now available to purchase for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles! This pack adds Gyutaro, the Upper Rank 6 of the Twelve Kizuki, to the game’s Versus mode (both locally and online), along with a new set of unique Gyutaro profile photos and quotes.

Players can pick up the “Gyutaro Character Pack” on its own, or save with the Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles Character Pass! By purchasing the Character Pass, players will instantly unlock and save on all 5 character packs that have been released for the game, which includes the:

 Tengen Uzui Character Pack
 Nezuko Kamado (Advanced Demon Form) Character Pack
 Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke (Entertainment District) Character Pack
 Daki Character Pack
 Gyutaro Character Pack

notes.title: Tengen Uzui Joins the Playable Roster
notes.content:
"Tengen Uzui Character Pack” now on sale

Tengen Uzui, the Sound Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps who engaged in a fierce battle against demons in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc anime, is now available to purchase as part of a character pack for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles! This pack includes Tengen Uzui as a playable character in Versus mode (both locally and online), along with a set of Tengen Uzui profile photos and quotes.

To commemorate the launch of the Tengen Uzui Character Pack, a free update is now available that adds a new stage – “Entertainment District” – which can be enjoyed in Versus mode.

Unlock the Character Pass

The Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles Character Pass is also now available to buy! By picking up this bundle, players will unlock and save on 5 different character packs that are scheduled to be released by the end of December 2022.

These packs will be distributed periodically over 5 separate releases that will include:
Tengen Uzui
Nezuko Kamado (Advanced Demon Form)
Tanjiro Kamado (Entertainment District)
Zenitsu Agatsuma (Entertainment District)
Inosuke Hashibira (Entertainment District)
Daki
Gyutaro
Each character pack also comes with their own profile photos and quotes.

Kimetsu Academy Summer Uniforms

Finally, the Kimetsu Academy Summer Uniforms, previously only available in the Nintendo Switch version of the game, are now available to buy on Steam. This set includes summer costumes for:
Kimetsu Academy Tanjiro Kamado
Kimetsu Academy Nezuko Kamado
Kimetsu Academy Zenitsu Agatsuma
Kimetsu Academy Inosuke Hashibira
Kimetsu Academy Giyu Tomioka

notes.title: [v1.30] Balance Changes
notes.content:
Our latest update for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles includes several balance changes made to the game. Please read the changelog below:

Combat Changes
Air Hop Adjustments Shortened homing attack/movement invulnerability window. Lengthened wait time after landing.Chase Dash AdjustmentsCan no longer be canceled with Quick Step when far from the opponent. (When near, it will behave as normal.)Throw AdjustmentsIncreased damage of throw attack.
Character Changes
Tanjiro Kamado / Academy TanjiroSkill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed and reduced mobility/speed of attack hitbox.Sakonji UrokodakiSkill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed attack hitbox and removed ability to cancel a long-press modified attack if it does not hit the opponent.Nezuko Kamado / Academy NezukoSupport Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching) / Support Skill 2 (Heel Bash): Shortened combo window.Support Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching): Reduced damage dealt to an opponent's guard.These adjustments only apply when Nezuko attacks as a support character.RuiSkill 1 (Web Toss) / Skill 2 (Thread Dash): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.AkazaChase Dash: Increased base speed.Skill 1 (Destructive Death: Air Type): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Disorder) / Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle):  Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard and shortened skill cooldown.Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle): Increased damage and lengthened combo window.Demon Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Annihilation Type): Increased damage and shortened combo window.YahabaDemon Skill 2 (Blood Demon Art: Kouketsu Arrow, Eruption): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.SusamaruSkill 1 (Ball Kick) / Demon Skill 1 (Sixfold Temari): Increased damage dealt to both an opponent's guard and the opponent guarding.Skill 2 (Spinning Throw): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.Skill 3 (Piercing Kick): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard when the button is held down.

notes.title: Digital Deluxe Edition Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

When Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles started pre-purchase on Steam, we shared that the Digital Deluxe Edition would contain a “Profile Background.”

Due to unforeseen circumstances, this item will be replaced with a “PC Wallpaper” instead. The Steam Digital Deluxe Edition will now offer:

 Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles game
 4 Character Unlocks
 3 Butterfly Mansion Costumes
 12 Character Avatars
 Kimetsu Points (8,000 Points)
 High-Resolution PC Wallpaper

If you pre-purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition from now until October 15th, you will also receive:

 2 Bonus Character Unlocks 
 1 Additional Character Avatar
 Access to play the game early, from October 13th

Thank you for your continued support!

Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles Team
